text:
mari: Heads up — release window starting in 30m but the CI matrix is failing on linux-x64/integration (deploybot is blocking promote).
ben: saw it, logs show missing artifact during setup.
sanjay: link to the failing job? I can look.
mari: https://ci.redwood/teams/main/builds/12098 — error shows `error: artifact not found: dist/service-linux-x64.tar.gz` from the runner setup step.
ci-bot: [job 12098] linux-x64/integration — FAILED after 00:04:22 — exit_code=2
ben: runner seems ephemeral; we had a transient S3 503 earlier that caused one of the artifact uploads to abort.
deploybot: promote blocked — reason: missing artifact(s) for build 12098. Manual pin available: last known good build 12090.
release-manager: we can't promote 12098. Options: wait for rerun, reupload artifact, or pin to 12090 and proceed with the change window.
mari: what does rollback vs pin mean here? prefer not to delay the release window.
sanjay: quick triage — if we pin to 12090 we must confirm there are no security or critical fixes in 12098.
ben: confirmed 12098 only contains perf tweak and flaky test fixes. Not a blocker to release; safe to pin.
mari: ok propose: pin to 12090, update release notes with perf tweak note and file follow-up ticket for artifact reupload + investigation.
release-manager: agreed. I'll update release-notes draft and note the manual pin. Can we have deploybot do a manual promote to prod after I ack?
deploybot: manual promote queued for build 12090 by @release-manager. Will perform canary rollout in 10m and escalate on 5% error spike.
ci-bot: scheduling a rerun of 12098 build pipeline for debugging, retaining artifacts for debugging only.
sanjay: leaving a note — possibly a parallel-upload race between matrix shards and the upload worker. I'll dig in post-release.
mari: thanks — please add a short entry to release notes: "Pinned to 12090 due to transient artifact upload failure; pending investigation (ENG-3421)" :memo:
release-manager: done. manual promote in progress :shipit:
ben: ping if anything spikes during canary and we'll abort.
mari: moving forward with pin; follow-up owners: @sanjay on investigation, @ben on rerun verification.
ci-bot: [job 12105] promote 12090 — canary started.
deploybot: canary stable at 3% traffic, no errors.
mari: closing thread for the release window. we'll reopen if deploybot reports any anomaly. :eyes:
